title: Mould-Risk Humidity Watch
dataSources: Mould risk (`mould:risk`), crack meters (`crackmeter:reading`), HVAC filter life (`hvacfilter:life`), structural tilt (`structural:tilt`).
app: Building-health sensors — indoor humidity / mould-risk monitors, crack and tilt meters, HVAC filter-life trackers, and damp sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and ESPHome.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mould:risk
| eval dewpoint_gap=surface_temp_c-dewpoint_c
| stats latest(humidity_pct) as humidity, latest(dewpoint_gap) as gap by room
| eval risk=if(humidity>70 OR gap<3,1,0)
| where risk=1
description: Watches each room for the sustained high humidity and cold surfaces that let mould take hold.
value: Mould damages health and homes and is far cheaper to prevent than remove; an early humidity warning triggers ventilation in time.
implementation: Ingest room humidity and surface temperature into `index=personal`; alert on mould-risk conditions.
visualization: Table of rooms at mould risk with humidity and margin.
grandmaExplanation: It watches for the damp, cold conditions that grow mould, warning you to ventilate before it takes hold.
